jobs.occupation: Service Technology and Automation Lead - Global Service
jobs.description:
We are looking for an experienced and commercially minded Service Technology and Automation Lead to modernize our global Customer Service setup. You will drive the implementation of service technology, AI and automation to deliver best-in-class customer experience while improving operational efficiency.

Working closely with Global and Local Service teams, you will optimize processes, develop our global service platform and translate business needs into practical solutions. Your focus will be on increasing efficiency, strengthening service quality and making it easier for customers and partners to do business with us.

**Welcome to Global Sales

**You will join Global Sales, Training and Service within Demant’s Hearing Aids business, where we work to improve the lives of people with hearing loss around the world. We deliver product and sales training, commercial excellence and customer service excellence to our sales companies across Europe, Asia-Pacific, Latin America, the Middle East and Africa, as well as to our independent distributors.

You will become part of our newly established Global Service department, consisting of 14 colleagues. Reporting to the Head of Global Service and joining the Global Service leadership team, you will help define and implement service excellence across our global organization.

**Drive Global Service Efficiency and Automation

**Joining us, you will drive the digitalization of Customer Service through standardized processes, modern technology, AI and automation. You will collaborate with local teams to identify opportunities, develop solutions and ensure successful implementation and adoption.

Success requires a good understanding of Customer Service operations and the ability to use technology to improve efficiency without compromising the personal relationships that underpin great service.

In this role, you will:

• Own and develop Salesforce Service Cloud, including its global rollout, functionality, user experience and roadmap.

• Drive platform adoption and performance, using data and insights to help markets maximize value and identify improvements.

• Implement AI and automation solutions to optimize workflows, improve service quality and increase operational efficiency.

• Define global service standards and guide markets in optimizing technologies such as IVR, workforce management and knowledge repositories.

• Develop customer and partner integrations for larger customers, maintaining the integration roadmap with Global IT.

• Drive stakeholder engagement and implementation, building alignment and momentum across global and local teams.

You can expect approximately 10–20 travel days per year to support our markets and understand local service operations.

**What You Bring

**You hold a relevant commercial master’s degree and ideally have around five years of experience in a similar function, preferably within a larger international organization. You have a track record of improving Customer Service performance and implementing new solutions.

You understand Customer Service at strategic, tactical and operational levels and know how to optimize processes, systems and ways of working. With a good commercial mindset, you recognize how service excellence contributes to customer satisfaction and business performance.

You thrive at the intersection of Customer Service, data, AI and technology. You have experience implementing AI solutions in a business context and translating insights into measurable improvements. Experience with Salesforce Service Cloud, Power BI or similar platforms is an advantage.

As a colleague, you are structured, analytical and collaborative. You can lead projects across organizational boundaries, influence and challenge stakeholders at different levels, and balance global standards with local needs. Your excellent communication and presentation skills enable you to build relationships and create engagement across cultures and functions.

**Come and join us

**This is an opportunity to shape the future of Customer Service across Demant’s global Hearing Aids business. You will work with colleagues and stakeholders across international markets to make our service operations more efficient, scalable and customer-focused through technology, AI and automation.

If you enjoy combining commercial insight, technology and collaboration to create tangible business improvements, we would like to hear from you.

Please submit your CV before the application deadline on November 5.

For inquiries regarding the application process, please use the online application form.

To learn more about the position, contact Steen Busk Marner, Head of Global Service, at skma@demant.com.

We are curious to meet you!

**Recruitment Process Information

**We will begin inviting candidates for interviews after the application deadline. First round of interviews are scheduled for the 12, 13, 16, and 17 of November. You can expect the final round of interviews to be held on the 24 and 25 of November.

jobs.occupation: Product Engineer
jobs.description:
At Complir we are building the system to enable safer physical products being sold across markets. The world of product compliance has been stuck in legacy systems, excel sheets and the brains of experts. The increasing amount of regulations and complexity is breaking these old systems, making it increasingly hard to sell safe compliant products to consumers. We are building the product that enables compliance experts to stay afloat.

We are a small team of generalists working on all parts of the stack. One day you might be working on improving the reliability of our AI systems, another you might be tweaking the UI of the product. Our team is one of high trust, collaboration and autonomy, therefore we’re looking for engineers who thrive when given responsibility from day one and are not afraid to figure out things on their own. We ship early and iterate directly with customers, therefore you will be expected to be comfortable talking directly to the users using the software you will build.

****Location

****Our office is located in Copenhagen and you will be expected to work in person. We will provide the necessary help with relocation if needed.

****Day to day at Complir

• You will be working directly with the founders, customers and our in house specialists and you will help figure out what needs to be built

• Build AI native software that integrates with the latest models to solve our customers' hardest problems. (we have plenty of tokens)

• Build durable workflows to understand customers' unstructured data.

• Improve the data structures that connects cross border regulatory data

• Surface novel insights from unstructured and structured data

****What we’re looking for

• At least 2-5 years of experience

• Strong understanding of React and TypeScript, with experience of working across the full stack. You understand browsers, but also the ins and outs of databases

• Product taste. You have opinions about UI/UX and enjoy iterating to get to the correct product shape

• High agency. You take responsibility and are able to work without a PM giving you tickets

• Experience working at a startup

****What we offer

• Small collaborative team. We work hard but have a lot of fun. We are a diverse set of people with different backgrounds

• Employee friendly equity package

• Competitive salary

• Work at a venture backed startup. Read our latest 11m seed round led by GC here: https://www.complir.io/resources/news/complir-raises-11m-seed

• Assistance with relocation if need be

• 0 -> 1 work. Have real influence on how the product is shaped and work on green field projects

jobs.occupation: Senior Full-Stack Developer – Modern Engineering & Agentic Coding
jobs.description:
If you care about doing full-stack development the right way – through clean architecture, automation, CI/CD, IaC, observability, golden paths, and engineering foundations – you’ll feel right at home at the Tech Collective, where we combine deep technical skills with real client impact.

**What You’ll Do

**Life as a consultant is different from a typical in-house role. At the Tech Collective, consulting means working on a wide range of projects with various clients – so you'll regularly encounter new challenges and have plenty of opportunities to grow your skills quickly.

We believe AI and agentic coding accelerate great developer practices – they do not replace them. That’s why solid architecture, quality, security, maintainability, and sound technical judgement matter more than ever.

In this senior role, you’ll help us understand client needs and turn them into real outcomes by taking technical ownership, guiding teams, and delivering robust solutions from idea to production.

• Build, test, and deliver software using modern engineering practices such as everything-as-code, CI/CD, GitOps, automation, and open-source principles

• Act as a trusted advisor to clients, helping them make great decisions and turn ideas into practical solutions

• Work across frontend and backend technologies, taking part in architectural decisions, system design, containerised environments, and clear, maintainable documentation

• Improve developer and user experience by shifting quality left, applying strong design principles, mentoring others, and delivering minimum viable products with a clear path to scale

• Design, build, and operate platforms and infrastructure, including APIs, CLIs, platform engineering, immutable infrastructure, and internal developer platforms

• Collaborate, teach, and lead through effective communication, technical writing, code reviews, lean principles, and strong data and security practices

• Lead technical workstreams and collaborate closely with clients, translating business needs into pragmatic technical solutions

**What You’ll Bring

**One thing that can be said of all your future colleagues is that we’re curious by nature, have a team-first mindset, a good sense of humour, and clear opinions on how tech can create value for our clients. If this sounds like you, you’ll be a great fit at The Tech Collective.

We’re looking for people with a relevant M.Sc. (this is mandatory and could be, for example, in computer science or software engineering) who are based within commuting distance of our office in Copenhagen.

**We’re looking for someone with a minimum of 5 years of professional experience in full-stack software development or similar engineering roles.

**On top of that, the ideal candidate is someone who brings senior engineering experience and:

• Communicates clearly in both written and spoken English

• Shares our values around software quality and delivery

• Enjoys working closely with clients and building trusted relationships with them

• Is tool-agnostic and chooses the right tool for the job

• Is comfortable with complexity and able to break problems down into manageable pieces

• Has solid experience building and operating modern software systems in production

• Understands software architecture, system design, testing, security, and maintainability

• Can guide technical decisions, challenge assumptions, and communicate trade-offs clearly

• Has experience mentoring or supporting other developers through code reviews, pairing, or technical sparring

Please note that you don’t need to meet all the criteria. The most important thing is that you have an engineering foundation, a senior mindset, consulting skills and curiosity to keep learning and growing.

**What We Offer

**When you step into our office, you step into a world of nerdery – and we love it and intend to keep it that way. You’ll become part of a low-ego, high-trust team of sharp engineers who you’ll work closely with from day one.

**Working With Us Means

**

• Real autonomy, real impact: you’ll own features end to end and lean into the tech you care most about.

• Growth that matters: a learning programme, mentoring, and plenty of peer knowledge sharing.

• Community and craft: strategy trips, meetups, and events across The Tech Collective/Implement Consulting Group.

Ready to shape the digital future with us? Let us know why and how in your cover letter and apply ASAP.

We’re on holiday during July, so please expect slightly longer response times.

jobs.occupation: Senior Research DSP Engineer
jobs.description:
Senior Research DSP Engineer

Location: Snekkersten.

Are you an experienced DSP Engineer ready to broaden your technical scope and help shape the hearing solutions of the future?

At Eriksholm Research Centre, we are looking for a technically strong and practically minded Senior Research DSP Engineer to join our scientific team. You will help mature promising research ideas into robust concepts, demonstrators, and technical solutions that can move closer to adoption by R&D.

About the position

Eriksholm generates scientific insights and explores new technologies with the potential to improve future hearing care. We work closely with scientists, engineers, and Oticon R&D to ensure that promising ideas can be translated into solutions with meaningful impact for people with hearing loss.

In this position, you will bridge scientific exploration and engineering implementation. You will combine strong digital signal processing and acoustics expertise with hands-on experimental work, modelling, and prototype development.

You will collaborate closely with scientists and development specialists, helping teams assess technical feasibility, build convincing demonstrations, and mature early-stage concepts for further development.

Your responsibilities will include:

• Developing and evaluating audio and DSP concepts for hearing aids.

• Translating scientific ideas into working algorithms, prototypes, and demonstrators.

• Designing acoustic measurements and experimental laboratory setups.

• Building models and tools for analysing and validating technical concepts.

• Supporting the maturation and technical transfer of promising research solutions towards R&D.

• Contributing to the development and maintenance of research hearing-aid platforms and laboratory capabilities.

• Providing technical support across scientific projects involving areas such as own-voice processing, acoustic perception, and data-driven signal processing.

• Taking responsibility for selected laboratory equipment, methods, and workflows.

The ideal candidate

You are curious, analytical, and motivated by solving complex technical problems. You enjoy moving between theory, modelling, implementation, and hands-on laboratory work. You are comfortable working with early-stage ideas where the path forward is not always fully defined.

You take ownership of your work, communicate technical topics clearly, and collaborate well with colleagues from different scientific and engineering disciplines. You also understand the importance of balancing scientific ambition with the practical requirements needed to bring a concept closer to product development.

We expect that you have:

• A master’s degree in electrical engineering, acoustical engineering, signal processing, or a related technical discipline.

• Several years of relevant experience in hearing-aid development, audio technology, or another technically related area. Experience from product development, research, technology exploration, or advanced engineering would all provide a strong foundation for this role.

• Strong knowledge of digital signal processing and acoustics.

• Experience with acoustic measurements, laboratory setups, modelling, and technical validation.

• Experience developing and evaluating algorithms in environments such as MATLAB, Python, or similar tools.

• The ability to translate complex technical challenges into structured experiments and practical solutions.

• Strong collaboration and communication skills.

• Professional proficiency in English.

Your workplace

The position is based on our site in Snekkersten, where you will work closely with Eriksholm’s multidisciplinary scientific community.

Eriksholm Research Centre is part of Oticon’s R&D organization. We pursue audiological discoveries with the potential to enhance customer and end-user benefits in future hearing care and work to ensure that scientific insights can be applied in solutions supporting people with hearing loss.

We are a multicultural and multidisciplinary team that values scientific integrity, collaboration, mutual respect, and openness. Our informal environment provides room to explore new ideas, challenge assumptions, and take considered technical risks.

Do you want to join Eriksholm Research Centre? Interested in our exciting position? - Deadline is the 22nd of November 2026.

Submit CV and a short, focused motivation in English reflecting the profile above.

We expect to hold the 1st interview on the 4th and 7th of December and the 2nd interview on the 15th and 17th of December.

Applications are only accepted via our online platform. We do not respond to inquiries from external suppliers.

For more information, please contact Sergi Rotger Griful, Senior Research Manager: SEGR@demant.com.

We are looking forward to hearing from you.

At Demant, we value diversity, equity and inclusion (DE&I), and we are committed to creating an inclusive working environment. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates regardless of ethnic background, personality, age, gender, and education. Diversity is part of our cultural DNA. Women in STEM areas are particularly encouraged to apply, as Demant supports United Nations Sustainable Development Goal 5 on gender equality. #LI-HYBRID#LI-BS1

About Demant

Demant is a world-leading hearing healthcare and technology group built on a heritage of care, health, and innovation since 1904. The Group offers innovative technologies, solutions, and expertise to help people hear better. In every aspect, from hearing care, hearing aids and hearing implants to diagnostic equipment and services and audio solutions, Demant is active and engaged. Headquartered in Denmark, the Group employs more than 21,000 people globally and is present with solutions in 130 countries where we create life-changing hearing health and high-end audio and video solutions. William Demant Foundation holds the majority of shares in Demant A/S, which is listed on Nasdaq Copenhagen and among the 25 most traded stocks.

jobs.occupation: Electro-Acoustic Engineer
jobs.description:
Electro-Acoustic Engineer

Denmark

Smørum

Electro Acoustic Development Engineer

If electro acoustic development of hearing instruments throughout the spectra form concept to finial product seems interesting, and if having fun at work makes you smile, then read on! We may just have the job for you.

In the Device Hardware area, we are looking for an Electro Acoustic engineer to expand our team. You will work with product development using cutting-edge tools in well-equipped modern facilities with the goal of developing the best hardware for our hearing instruments.

Join the Hardware development team

As an electro acoustic developer, you would be part of an agile development team with responsibility for design and verification of the electroacoustic concepts. We focus on delivering solutions that enable us to deliver high-quality hearing instrument solutions, including in-depth transducer knowledge and development of new acoustic concepts for future products. We are depending on, and facilitating, in-depth knowledge about vibroacoustic behavior of subsystems and complete hearing aid solutions.

We participate in product development as well as maturation of concepts, before they are used in product development. Sometimes we participate in after launch activities as well.

Building, documenting and sharing knowledge is key to our success. Communication of key findings and results gained in is cross functional cooperation with mechanical and electronics developers in our Agile Release Trains are sessional.

Building innovative Electro Acoustic Solutions

In collaboration with skilled team members within your own Agile Release Train, you will work to innovate electro acoustic and mechanical solutions that elevate the experience of both end-users and customers. The excitement this group faces daily is the development of highly complex platforms, due to the high degree of functionality that hearing instruments offer. Furthermore, we focus on developing our platforms to fit multiple brands, adding to the complexity. The team works closely together with other professionals, i.e., audiologists and engineers specializing in amplifiers and embedded systems.

The biggest hardware challenge is to develop a platform that provides the needed acoustical gain and at the same time securing a good mechanical and acoustic feedback margin. Here a close cooperation with the mechanical engineers and the pre-production team is crucial for a good result.

You will be involved in:

• Acoustic systemdesign and Development

• Platform calibration/settings

• Design specifications

• Selection of components i.e. transducers – microphones, receivers/speakers

• Testing, verifying and documenting electro-acoustical performance of HW platforms

• Effort estimation and planning done in an agile framework

In the role of Electro Acoustic Developer, you will collaborate with skilled team members to advance the design of next-generation cutting-edge hearing instruments.

Apart from working together with motivated colleagues you will experience that we have great focus on your skills development, the department’s professional skills and in Work-life balance.

You can expect 1-5 travel days a year, visiting suppliers and our production site in Poland.

Qualifications

We expect you to hold a degree in Engineering, focusing specifically on electro acoustics. We anticipate that you possess strong qualifications in Sound Quality, Acoustic measurements, vibro-acoustics, and sound path design. Knowledge from working with electro acoustic or magnetic designs of hearing instruments or other smaller products such as cell phones, headsets or similar is an advantage.

You perform best in a vibrant atmosphere and enjoy partnering with experienced coworkers to make the most of your skills. We offer further development opportunities and believe Oticon is a good place to develop your career further.

As a person, you are proud of your profession, curious and a team player by heart. You have good communication skills and enjoy networking and navigating in a delivery driven, cross-functional organization with several parallel development tracs.

jobs.occupation: Head of Europe Financial Control and Governance
jobs.description:
Are you passionate about? Do you have experience within financial control and governance?

If so, now is your chance to join Ascendis Pharma as our new Head of Europe financial control and governance.

Ascendis Pharma is a global biopharmaceutical company committed to making a meaningful difference in patients' lives. Guided by our core values of Patients, Science, and Passion, we are applying our innovative TransCon® technology platform to fulfill our mission of developing new therapies that demonstrate best-in-class potential to address unmet medical needs.

At our headquarters in Hellerup, Denmark, research facilities in Heidelberg, Germany, and additional offices across Europe and the United States, we are advancing programs in our Endocrinology Rare Disease and Oncology portfolios. We also collaborate with partners on the development of TransCon-based products in other therapeutic areas and markets.

We are seeking a passionate Head of Europe financial control and governance to join our growing team. As a key member of the Ascendis Pharma team, you will play a crucial role in Europe regional oversight, assurance and coordination across European entities. This is an exciting opportunity to work in a fast-paced environment, collaborate with cross-functional, global teams working together to achieve extraordinary results.

You will be joining the finance operations team consisting of 33 colleagues, and report directly to Cicek Wrabetz, Head of Europe Finance Operations who is based in Munich, Germany. You will be based in Hellerup, Denmark.

Your key responsibilities will be:

• Lead regional governance and assurance. Maintain oversight of material accounting, reporting, control and compliance matters across Europe. Identify gaps, clarify ownership and coordinate resolution across teams and countries

• Oversee financial reporting and accounting. Coordinate statutory reporting and external audits across European jurisdictions and provide assurance over close, financial reporting and internal controls

• Navigate local requirements. Bring structure to country-specific requirements, including withholding tax, statutory obligations and invoicing, working closely with Tax, Legal, Compliance, Treasury and relevant process owners

• Drive launch and change readiness. Represent the European financial-control and governance perspective in new-market and entity launches, identifying local requirements and impacts across processes, systems, data and controls

• Simplify and strengthen ways of working. Challenge unnecessary complexity, country variations and manual workarounds. Identify root causes, clarify ownership and help implement compliant, scalable and sustainable solutions

• Leverage technology, AI and automation. Partner with Finance Systems and process owners to translate business needs and pain points into well-defined, controllable and scalable solutions, using technology where it creates meaningful value

Qualifications and Skills:

You hold a relevant academic degree - preferably a MBA or Bachelor of Management /Economics/ business administration or equivalent - and 10+ years of experience including meaningful responsibility for accounting, financial operations, monthly close, managing external accountants, auditors and controls.

Furthermore, you have:

• 5+ years of experience within external or internal audit, controllership, financial control, Finance Operations, transformation, or a related field in an international environment

• Strong knowledge of accounting, IFRS, internal controls, audit, and European statutory and regulatory requirements

• A professional qualification such as CPA, Cand.merc.aud., ACCA, Wirtschaftsprüfer, or equivalent is preferred

• Demonstrated experience in strengthening controls, redesigning processes, and simplifying ways of working

• Experience working across countries and functions, including O2C, P2P, R2R, Tax, Treasury, Legal, Compliance, and Finance Systems

• Interest in and hands-on experience with ERP systems, analytics, automation, AI, or digital finance initiatives. Experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365 is an advantage

Key competencies:

You are a strong team player, analytical, and have a can-do attitude.

You possess an entrepreneurial mindset and can thrive in an informal, open environment where innovation and change are key.

To succeed in this role, we also expect you to

• Challenge complexity and has evidence of making processes simpler, stronger or more scalable

• Collaborate across functions and geographies and influences without relying on formal authority

• Balance control, compliance, business needs and practical implementation

Travel: 10-20 days per year.

Office: Ascendis Pharma A/S Tuborg Boulevard 12, 2900 Hellerup, Denmark

Apply now.

We evaluate applications when received, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible. Please note that we conduct interviews on a rolling basis and reserve the right to remove the job posting at any time.

To ensure your application is reviewed, please submit it through the specified platform - applications sent by email or other channels will not be evaluated.

For more details about the position or the company, please contact Cicek Wrabetz, Head of Europe Finance Operations, cwz@ascendispharma.com

You can learn more about Ascendis by visiting our website www.ascendispharma.com

Applications must be submitted in English and will be treated confidentially.

A note to recruiters:

We do not allow external search party solicitation.  Presentation of candidates without written permission from the Ascendis Pharma HR team (specifically from: Talent Acquisition Partner or Human Resources Director) is not allowed.  If this occurs, your ownership of these candidates will not be acknowledged.

We are looking for a responsible, structured, and solution-oriented individual with strong attention to detail. You are comfortable working both on construction sites and in a site office, and you can communicate effectively with different trades and project stakeholders.

•         Be able to read and interpret construction drawings and technical documentation.

•         Work independently, systematically, and take ownership of your tasks.

•         Communicate effectively in English or Danish, both verbally and in writing.

•         Be comfortable using digital tools for inspections and quality documentation.

•         Previous experience in QA/QC, quality inspections, or construction site supervision.

•         Knowledge of passive fire protection, insulation, or similar construction activities.

•         Experience working with Dalux and BIM.

•         Good Danish language skills and knowledge of additional languages.

A specific educational background is not required. We value relevant practical experience, technical understanding, and the right attitude.

What We Offer

•         A permanent, full-time position with a minimum of 37 working hours per week.

•         Start date as soon as possible or by agreement.

•         Competitive salary based on qualifications and experience, including pension and other employment benefits in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and employment contract.

•         Company phone and the possibility of a company vehicle, depending on project requirements.

•         A varied workday combining on-site inspections with office-based QA/QC activities.

•         A supportive and informal working environment with opportunities for professional development.

About Firesafe Danmark A/S

Firesafe Danmark A/S specialises in passive fire protection and related technical services within the construction industry.

Our work contributes to protecting people, buildings, and assets by ensuring that fire protection systems are correctly installed, inspected, and documented in accordance with project specifications and applicable requirements.

You will become part of a team where quality, teamwork, and accountability are at the core of our daily operations.

jobs.occupation: Senior Analyst, JOE Insights
jobs.description:
**WHY WORK AT JOE & THE JUICE

**JOE & THE JUICE is a people-centric food and beverage company built around culture, offering much more than just juice, sandwiches, and coffee.

We believe in four simple virtues that shape everything we do:

• Positive Attitude

• Inclusion

• Social Ties

• Growth

For us, this means that when you choose a cup-half-full mindset, welcome people from every background, build real friendships across the bar by creating great guest experiences, and use every shift as a chance to learn something new, you become more than just a Juicer; like us, you continue to search and find purpose and meaning in what you do.

From your first day, you'll be part of an international network of Juicers who support each other, celebrate wins together, and push each other to grow. You will learn by doing and move through our Moneyball career path, our internal system that tracks your performance and fast-tracks you toward promotion. Most of our leaders have earned their stripes behind the bar (fun fact: over 75% of our employees started as Juicers!), so you will always be part of a company built on that same journey. If you love a fast-paced environment, music, and people, and you like the idea of turning a job into a lifestyle, JOE can become a place to build skills, friendships, and a career that takes you across cities, countries, and roles.

**JOB SUMMARY

**JOE & THE JUICE is on an ambitious global growth trajectory - scaling toward 1,000+ bars, preparing for an IPO, and building the infrastructure of a world-class public company. As Senior Analyst in JOE Insights, our analytics function within FP&A, you will report to the Head of BI and turn raw data into sharp, commercially relevant insights for senior management. Your analysis will directly inform decisions from same store sales performance to new launches and commercial initiatives.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

**

• Build detailed, high quality insights pieces that inform decisions made by senior management, translating data into clear commercial narratives

• Own, build and support financial modelling and analytics work related to JOE's growth journey

• Partner with FP&A, BI, and business stakeholders to answer priority questions with structured, rigorous analysis

• Work with SQL, BI, and AI tools to pull, shape, and validate the data behind every insight, and know it well enough to defend every number

• Support strategic initiatives, contributing analysis and insight that enable well informed decision making across the organization

• Conduct competitor and macroeconomic analysis, including tracking input price developments across the business

• Challenge and sanity check numbers before they reach leadership, ensuring every insight is accurate, defensible, and decision ready

• Turn open ended, loosely defined questions into structured analyses with a clear point of view on what the business should do next

• Build and maintain analytical frameworks and templates that make future insights pieces faster and sharper to produce

• Contribute to building JOE Insights into a best in class analytics function, helping shape how the team works as it grows

**WHO YOU ARE

**

• You are curious and thorough, and you do not settle for the first answer a dataset gives you

• You take pride in producing analysis that holds up to scrutiny, not just analysis that is directionally right

• You are as comfortable in a spreadsheet as you are explaining what it means to a stakeholder

• You filter complexity down to the insight that matters, hold yourself to a high standard, and take ownership of your work from first question to final slide

**WHAT YOU'LL BRING

**

• 2-4 years of experience from investment banking, transaction advisory, strategy consulting, corporate finance, or FP&A

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Finance, Economics, Business Administration, or a similarly quantitative field

• Strong analytical depth combined with a genuinely commercial mindset - you connect numbers to what they mean for the business

• High work ethic and ownership, comfortable moving from an open ended question to a sharp, structured answer with limited guidance

• Strong PowerPoint and Excel skills are required; experience with SQL and BI tools is a significant plus

• Excellent communication skills, able to distill complex analysis into insights that senior leaders can act on quickly

• Fluency in English, and a base in Copenhagen or willingness to commute daily

**OUR BENEFITS

**We offer a benefits package that includes a paid pension plan, health insurance, parental leave, and additional vacation. Besides that, we provide some JOE-ified benefits:

• Our global headquarters is conveniently located in the heart of beautiful Copenhagen, where over 200 friendly faces come together!

• Fantastic office facilities, including a fully staffed JOE & THE JUICE bar, where we serve delicious breakfast, daily lunch, refreshing juices, and top-notch barista coffee

• At JOE, we embrace a flat hierarchy that values every opinion, creating a welcoming space for your ideas and suggestions to thrive

• Lively monthly social calendar filled with fun activities like running club, wine tasting, creative evenings, and Friday bars - there's always something exciting happening!

• As part of our team, you'll have the opportunity to take on a BTC (Behind the Counter) shift in one of our bars twice a year, adding a unique touch to your experience

Ready to turn a job into a lifestyle?

**ABOUT JOE & THE JUICE

**Founded in Copenhagen in 2002, JOE & THE JUICE has grown into a global fast-casual concept with more than 500 locations across 25+ countries and over 7,000 employees worldwide, with our sights set on 1,000 stores by 2028.

Our people-centric culture and sustainability agenda are part of our Nordic heritage, and remain central to our commitment to a better future. Along the way, internal workshops and mentorship sharpen your skills, while exchange programs and international assignments can take you across our markets.

Ready to embark on this exciting journey? Apply today and become a part of JOE & THE JUICE!

jobs.occupation: Project Manager for development projects at DEIF
jobs.description:
Are you a proactive project manager who enjoys creating momentum, following up on actions, and ensuring that projects stay on track? Would you like to become part of a dynamic and innovative environment and contribute to the green energy transition? Then have a look at this exciting job opportunity at DEIF A/S!

At DEIF A/S, we develop advanced control solutions that keep power stable and efficient – whether from wind, solar, or traditional sources. With more than 700 employees worldwide, we set new standards in energy efficiency and power conversion, working every day to become the market leader in intelligent energy control. Together, we create solutions that Improve Tomorrow.

**About The Job

**DEIF A/S is a global leader in power management solutions, committed to innovation and sustainability. As Project Manager within Product Development, you will drive development projects from idea to implementation, working closely with software, hardware, mechanical, and test teams. This role is ideal for someone who thrives on creating momentum, turning plans into action, and ensuring projects move forward according to plan. You will manage projects of varying sizes and complexity, from smaller specialist-driven initiatives to larger cross-functional development programs.

"In this role, you will be the driving force behind day-to-day project execution. You will create structure, align teams, follow up on deliverables, and ensure that plans are transformed into concrete results. Success requires a proactive and pragmatic mindset, a strong sense of ownership, and a go-do attitude that helps teams overcome challenges and maintain momentum," explains Vice President, Martin Mallan

**Working Tasks & Responsibilities

**

• Lead and manage product development projects of varying size and complexity

• Create and maintain project plans, timelines, milestones, and follow-up activities

• Drive project execution and ensure tasks, actions, and deliverables are completed on time

• Coordinate activities across software, hardware, mechanical, and test teams

• Facilitate project meetings, track progress, and ensure clear communication among stakeholders

• Identify challenges, dependencies, and risks, and proactively drive mitigation actions

• Support resource planning and help ensure effective prioritization across project activities

• Provide transparency through status reporting, project dashboards, and regular follow-up

• Ensure project objectives, scope, quality, and timelines are aligned with business expectations

• Contribute to continuous improvements of project management processes and ways of working

**What You’ll Bring

**First of all, you are a structured and proactive project manager who enjoys driving progress and creating results through collaboration. jobs.occupation: Senior Data Scientist
jobs.description:
Copenhagen, Denmark

_Do you want to work with data engineering, platform development, and data-based automated processes within Saxo's Financial Crime Prevention (FCP)?

_**About The Job

**Saxo is an investment bank with high speed, global colleagues, and a strong focus on using technology and data to prevent financial crime. We are looking for a Senior Data Engineer to join the FCP Modelling & Development team.

FCP Modelling & Development is part of the 1st Line of Defence in Group Operations and is located in Saxo's headquarters in Hellerup. The team works with models and data-based automated processes used across FCP. The goal is to ensure that these data assets and processes are sound, fit for purpose, adequately documented, secure, and regularly reviewed.

**Responsibilities

**

• Build, operate, and continuously improve reusable AML data products, data-modelling components, and user-facing interfaces, with clear ownership, lineage, documentation, quality controls, and production reliability.

• Design robust ETL pipelines and integration interfaces for operational, analytical, model-development, and external-platform use cases, enabling secure and efficient data exchange across internal and external systems.

• Translate FCP and AML requirements into durable, adaptable production systems, contributing to solution architecture decisions on design patterns, system scalability, regulatory compliance, and flexibility across AML processes.

• Partner with FCP and AML subject-matter experts on transaction monitoring, customer segmentation, scenario development, client risk rating, surveillance support, and AML-related development initiatives that strengthen financial crime prevention capabilities.

• Define automated checks for completeness, consistency, validity, reconciliation, source-to-target integrity, architectural integrity, security, performance, and governance standards.

• Own observability, alerting, incident response, backfills, runbooks, performance tuning, production support, and operational resilience for critical data assets.

• Raise engineering standards through design and code reviews, mentoring, reusable patterns, clean and well-documented code, test-driven development, secure coding practices, CI/CD pipeline optimization, automated testing, and continuous improvement.

**What You Bring

**

• 5+ years of experience in data engineering, software engineering, or a related production data role.

• Strong Python, SQL, and Spark skills, with experience building and maintaining production data pipelines and data models.

• Practical experience with modern data platforms such as Databricks, Kafka, Snowflake, Airflow, Azure, or similar technologies.

• Experience supporting ML workflows, including feature engineering, feature data preparation, dataset versioning, reproducible training and validation datasets, model-validation support, and production-ready model inputs.

• Deployment skills for production workloads, including CI/CD, containerized services, and Kubernetes or similar orchestration platforms.

• Strong understanding of authentication, authorization, data access controls, encryption, secure handling of sensitive data, and practical data-security patterns using Azure services such as Microsoft Entra ID, Azure Key Vault, Azure RBAC, and Managed Identities.

• Hands-on experience maintaining production data pipelines, including data quality testing, reconciliation, lineage, metadata management, documentation, monitoring, and operational controls.

• Experience with financial crime prevention in regulated financial services, including AML, KYC/CDD/ODD, sanctions screening, transaction monitoring, client risk rating, and market-abuse surveillance support.

• Experience with GDPR-sensitive data, audit evidence, regulator-facing reporting, or data governance in control-heavy environments.

• Nice to have: experience with data quality validation tools e.g. Great Expectations (GX), dbt‑expectations, Soda, Deequ, or Microsoft Fabric.

• Clear communication in English with technical and non-technical stakeholders.

**We get curious people invested in the world

**When you work at Saxo, you become a Saxonian and part of a purpose-driven organisation, where good ideas are always taken seriously, and where you can make a true impact. We are invested in your development, and you can expect a robust career from day one when you join Saxo – no matter which role you take on.

You will join 2,500 other ambitious colleagues across 11 countries and become part of an international organisation. Working in Saxo, you will get to meet colleagues from many different cultures and backgrounds, and you should know that we value diversity and inclusion and see it as a genuine source of strength to drive growth, foster innovation and position us for long-term success.

We encourage an open feedback culture and supportive team environments enabling employees to grow and fulfil their career aspirations.

When you bring passion, curiosity, drive and team spirit, your learning journey will be dynamic and your career opportunities in Saxo will be immense.

At Saxo we don’t just offer a job – we offer an opportunity to invest in your future!

**How To Apply

**Click here to create an account and upload your resume and a short motivation. We look forward to getting to know you better!
